blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 63 in June to 50 in September (−20.6%), and it took 27.6% of the city’s 116 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 23 in June to 22 in September (−4.3%), and it took 28.6% of the city’s 35 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Sunshine Hills Woods for detached houses in July (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, September (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Lots and land in Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Strata vs freehold position, as stated: predominantly freehold detached houses; strata appears in the named townhome complexes at the area's edges.

Lot character — zone minimums, as stated (zoning number contested): single-detached minimum lots run RS1 at 4,000 m² (width 30 m, average depth 30 m), RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² or 460 m², RS6 at 390 m² (width 13 m, depth 30 m) and RS7 at 335 m² (width 11 m); duplex minimums run RD1 at 836 m², RD2 and RD3 at 4,000 m², and RD4 at 504 m²; there is no RD5 zone. These are bylaw-ladder minimums, not a claim that every lot is that size.

Area-typical lot size: UNVERIFIED: The established Sunshine Hills / Sunshine Woods streets are known locally for larger-than-average North Delta lots, but a City source stating an area-typical lot size was not found — no typical size is invented here; the zone for a specific lot is confirmed on the City zoning maps.
Cross-reference — Sunridge Estates (6712 Baker Rd, NWS1316)
Never-cite note applied

ALR vs non-ALR split: OCP Map 2 shows no Agricultural designation for this part of North Delta; property-level ALR status is a check through the Agricultural Land Commission. No ALR percentage split is stated.

Serviced vs unserviced: no parcel-level servicing statement is documented in the research — municipal water/sewer vs well/septic for any single lot is UNCONFIRMED here. Delta's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home, as the City states it for serviced single-family homes.

Buildable-area caution — Cougar Creek: Cougar Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse running through Surrey and Delta per City material, with City work on creek bank stabilization in Cougar Canyon; a floodplain designation specific to the residential streets was not confirmed, and streamside setback detail is lot-specific — a big lot near the canyon may not build like a big lot elsewhere.

Market context, labelled correctly: SnapStats recorded Sunshine Hills Woods Detached inventory 50 / solds 3 / sales ratio 6% (the softest detached ratio of the four North Delta sub-areas in September 2026) and Condos & Townhomes inventory 22 / solds 2 / sales ratio 9%; the parent community (North Delta) detached median was $1,100,000 that month. SnapStats has NO land category (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined only; North Delta IS a SnapStats-covered community — South Delta is NOT, and that coverage does not make any figure a land figure) — no detached figure is presented as a land figure.

72 Avenue corridor: a City corridor report confirms townhouse projects have been built along the 72 Avenue corridor under the Mixed Residential designation, and covers proposed 72 Avenue corridor pre-zoning (LU009876).
: No presale project in Sunshine Hills Woods was confirmed on a City or developer source in the research read.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta, BC — the southern tier of North Delta, around Watershed Park and Cougar Canyon.
Nearby areas: Scottsdale to the north-east across Scott Road, Nordel to the north, Panorama Ridge (Surrey) to the south across 64 Avenue, Burns Bog to the west beyond Watershed Park.
Search / alternate names: "Sunshine Hills" and "Sunshine Woods" separately (the two official City neighbourhood names); "Watershed Park" area; "Cougar Canyon" for the north-west pocket.

Roads and transit: 72 Avenue and 64 Avenue run east-west; Kittson Parkway cuts through the Watershed Park area; Scott Road (120 Street) is the east side; Highway 91 access is via 64 Avenue. Route 340 runs Scottsdale Exchange to 22nd Street Station via Scott Road, 64 Avenue, Kittson Parkway, Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge, through the Watershed Park edge; route 364 runs along the south edge; route 319 runs along the north edge; the R6 RapidBus runs on Scott Road at the east side.

Parks: Watershed Park, 11600 Kittson Pkwy, is described by the City as Delta's largest park, with eleven kilometres of gravel trails; Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Ave, and Westview Park is at 6500 Westview Dr.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Subdivision + servicing requirements — servicing bylaw UNCONFIRMED: Subdivision follows the zone minimums in; confirm subdivision and servicing requirements with the City for the parcel, from council / City process documents, before pricing subdivision potential.

Streamside / SPEA: any property within 30 m of a stream falls in Delta's Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, which can limit additions, coach houses and rebuilds — directly relevant on Cougar Creek lots when pricing suite or garden-suite potential.

ALR rules — framework only, no Agricultural designation documented for this ground: where a parcel is in the ALR, subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); BC Assessment farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sunshine Hills Woods

items.t: Watershed Park is Delta's largest park — and it shapes what land can ever be built on beside it. Watershed Park, 11600 Kittson Pkwy, has eleven kilometres of gravel trails; Cougar Canyon Environmental Reserve is at 11300 72 Ave. The park / canyon / Burns Bog side of the sub-area is open-space and streamside ground, not lot inventory.

No recreation centre or shopping centre inside the working grid was confirmed. The North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue serves North Delta, and George Mackie Library is at 8440 112th Street in Nordel — a lot here is bought for the park / canyon setting, with a drive for facilities.
The softest detached month in North Delta was here. Pricing land value off the North Delta community median alone misleads on tiny, soft numbers.
Delta's flat-rate utility fee is a line item land buyers forget. The City's 2026 flat-rate utility fee is $1,658 for a single-family home — a fixed annual cost outside property tax.

The former plan citation matters when reading old documents. Sunshine Hills and Sunshine Woods were neighbourhoods 12 and 13 in the former North Delta Area Plan, Schedule C.1 under the previous OCP Bylaw No. 3950 — not a schedule of the current Bylaw No. 8400, which has no lettered schedules at all.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Sunshine Hills Woods than in June?
faq.a: In Sunshine Hills Woods, listings of houses fell from 63 in June to 50 in September (−20.6%); condos and townhomes fell from 23 in June to 22 in September (−4.3%).

faq.q: How big is Sunshine Hills Woods compared with the rest of North Delta?
faq.a: In September 2026, Sunshine Hills Woods held 23.9% of the 209 houses listed in North Delta and 31.0% of the 71 condos and townhomes listed in North Delta.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 32 houses and 10 condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods over those 4 months.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How small can a lot be, and can I subdivide?
faq.a: The bylaw ladder runs RS7 at 335 m² up to RS1 at 4,000 m² for single-detached, and RD4 at 504 m² up to RD1 at 836 m² / RD2–RD3 at 4,000 m² for duplex — the parcel's zone decides. Subdivision and servicing requirements are confirmed with the City; the servicing-bylaw position is UNCONFIRMED in.

faq.q: Can I add a suite, coach house or garden suite?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH regulations allow garden suites and coach houses in combination with single detached and duplex dwellings where the zoning applies, and SSMUH is permitted on all single-detached and duplex lots citywide under Bylaws 8394 and 8395 (adopted June 24, 2024) — confirm the parcel's zone first.

faq.q: Does Cougar Creek cut into my buildable area?
faq.a: Possibly — the creek is salmon-bearing, streamside setback detail is lot-specific, and any property within 30 m of a stream is in the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area. Check the setback before valuing a lot's buildable area.

faq.q: Which OCP and zoning bylaw apply?
faq.a: OCP: consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), with no lettered schedules — "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw 8400" is an error. Zoning: the number is CONTESTED (7600, 2017 vs "8400, 2025") — confirm with the City, do not quote either as settled.

faq.q: Will GST apply on a vacant lot?
faq.a: Generally yes if the seller is a developer/business or the lot is newly subdivided; generally no for an individual's personal-use resale, per CRA GI-003.
